title: Deadpool 2
description: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool meets Russell, an angry teenage mutant who lives at an orphanage. When Russell becomes the target of Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future -- Deadpool realizes that he'll need some help saving the boy from such a superior enemy. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other powerful mutants to protect young Russell from Cable and his advanced weaponry.

title: Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow
description: With Americans spending thousands of dollars a year on wellness products, Oobah attempts to hack the industry by selling a so-called beauty serum made of children's tears and a supplement containing lab-grown human meat; after strategizing with marketing gurus, Oobah holds focus groups, sets up popup events and manipulates product ratings to generate buzz.

title: Rain Man
description: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt (Tom Cruise) learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has an autistic older brother named Raymond (Dustin Hoffman) and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
description: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in "A Christmas Carol," forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

title: Christmas With the Kranks
description: Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit.

title: The Hotline
description: An anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using drugs. Volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, creating collective hope amid addiction.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
description: Rachel Chu is happy to accompany her longtime boyfriend, Nick, to his best friend's wedding in Singapore. She's also surprised to learn that Nick's family is extremely wealthy, and he's considered one of the country's most eligible bachelors. Thrust into the spotlight, Rachel must now contend with jealous socialites, quirky relatives and something far, far worse -- Nick's disapproving mother.

title: The Magic Faraway Tree
description: Follow Polly, Tim and their three children as they begin a new life in a remote country village. When the kids discover a magical tree hidden near their home, they are welcomed by its enchanted residents and swept into spectacular, fantastical lands beyond their wildest imagination. With every adventure, they discover the magic that helps them reconnect with what matters most, each other.

When a weekend with Ellis' parents threatens to expose the truth, Adaline makes a decision that changes her life forever.
